description: Every business offering one product, by its barcode: each one's price as this network last checked it, whether it is in stock, where it is offered, and its own door to order through. In the published order unless you ask for another; a business has one place. The price that counts is the one the business's door gives you: read it there, show it to your person, and order there.

availability.description: Only offers with one of these: in_stock and on_sale (available, its stock not counted) when left out.

condition.description: Only offers in one of these conditions: any when left out.

country.description: Only businesses in this country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, like PT.

currency.description: Only offers in this currency (ISO 4217, like EUR). Prices are never converted.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same arguments.

gtin.description: The product's barcode: GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14, EAN, UPC or ISBN, in any length.

has_inbox.description: Every offer here comes from a business's own inbox: false leaves nothing.

near.description: Only offers of businesses within radius_km of this point, each with its distance.

radius_km.description: How far from the point, in kilometres: 10 when left out.

order.description: published (the default): each offer in its business's place in the directory's published order. price: lowest first, with currency. nearest: nearest first, with near.

price_max.description: At most this, in the currency's minor unit. Needs currency.

price_min.description: At least this, in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR, yen for JPY). Needs currency.

ships_to.description: Only businesses that say they deliver to this country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

name: get_offers

next_cursor.description: Pass it as cursor, with the same arguments, for the next page; null on the last.

note.description: Prices are each business's as this network last checked them; the door's price is the one that counts.

availability.description: in_stock, out_of_stock, or on_sale (available, its stock not counted; never a discount). Never a count.

checked_at.description: When this network last confirmed the business's catalogue.

gtin.description: The barcode, as 14 digits; null for a product with none.

id.description: This network's id of the offer.

image_url.description: A picture of it, where the business keeps it.

offered_by.description: The business that offers it, in this network's words.

domain.description: The business's own domain, where its inbox is.

standing.description: Its standing in the directory, in words, as get_business gives it.

order.description: The business's own door: read the price that counts there with read_first, then order with then; over HTTP, the same at rest.

product_id.description: The product's id at the business's door.

rest.description: Over HTTP: GET {rest}/products?ids={product_id} reads the price that counts, and POST {rest}/orders orders.

price.description: As this network last checked it, in the currency's minor unit.

tax.description: Whether the price includes tax, as the business said: unknown when it said nothing.

url.description: The product's page, on the business's own site.

where.description: Where it is offered: pickup when the business says it takes collection in person, and the countries it says it delivers to.

ships_to.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, or * for anywhere.

businesses.description: How many businesses offer it, each once.

kind.description: global, book, or serial (an issue's number: each business's own, matched to no other's).

rules.description: The rules that make the published order.

title: Offers of one product
